title: Library Preparation for small RNA sequencing using 4N adapters: In house 4N Protocol A
protocol: Resuspend the 5' adapter at 25 μM.
Resuspend the 3' adapter at 10 μM.
Resuspend the RT primer at 10 μM.
Resuspend the RP1 PCR primer at 20 μM.
Resuspend the indexed PCR primers (RPI1-48) at 20 μM.
Add 3 μL of 50% PEG 8000 into each strip tube.
Dry the tubes in a speedvac using low heat (37°C).
Cap the dried PEG strip tubes and store desiccated at room temperature.
Add x μL RNA to each strip tube.
Pipette 1 μL adenylated 3' adapter (10 μM stock concentration) into each strip tube.
Add water to a total volume of 5-x μL in each strip tube.
Heat the tube containing RNA and adapter to 70°C for 2 minutes.
Snap cool the heated tube on ice.
Incubate at 25°C for 2 hours.
Add 1 μg _E. coli_ SSB diluted in 1X ligase buffer and incubate at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Add 1 μL of 5’ deadenylase and incubate at 30°C for 1 hour.
Add 1 μL of RecJf and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Denature 1 μL of 5’ adapter in a separate tube at 70°C for 2 minutes, then snap cool on ice.
Add 1 μL 10mM ATP to the denatured 5’ adapter mix.
Add 1 μL T4 RNA ligase 1 to the denatured 5’ adapter mix.
Add 3 μL of adapter, ATP and ligase mix to the completed 3’ ligation for a total volume of 16 μL.
Incubate at 25°C for 1 hour.
Heat RT primer \(10 μM stock concentration) to 70°C for 2 min, then snap cool on ice.
Add 6 μL of ligated RNA to the tube containing RT primer and store leftover ligated RNA at -70°C.
Add 2 μL 5x First strand buffer to the reverse transcription mix.
Add 0.5 μL 12.5 mM dNTP mix to the reverse transcription mix.
Add 1 μL DTT to the reverse transcription mix.
Add 1 μL RNAseOut to the reverse transcription mix.
Add 1 μL Superscript III to the reverse transcription mix.
Add 7 μL denatured RNA/primer to a total of 12.5 μL RT reaction.
Incubate the RT reaction at 55°C for 1 hour.
Incubate the RT reaction at 70°C for 15 minutes.
Add 1 μL RiboShredder RNAse blend and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Mix 25 μL PCR master mix, 2 μL Illumina RP1, 2 μL reverse index primer, 8 μL water, and 13 μL cDNA to a total volume of 50 μL.

Amplify the mixture using the program: initial denaturation at 98°C for 30 seconds, followed by 15-20 cycles of denaturation at 98°C for 10 seconds, annealing at 60°C for 30 seconds, and extension at 65°C for 35 seconds. Final extension is performed at 65°C for 2 minutes.
Purify the PCR product using DNA Clean and Concentrator 5 columns and elute in 50 μL or a smaller amount as desired.
Add 12.5 μL 5X Novex TBE sample loading buffer to the PCR product.
Load the PCR product into three lanes on a 6% TBE gel.
Run the gel for approximately 80 minutes at 100 volts.
Stain the gel with Sybr Gold and cut out the band at approximately 149 bp.
Crush gel slice in Gel-breaker tube.
Soak fragments overnight in 300 μL Qiagen EB buffer at room temperature in Thermomixer.
Spin through SpinX column (Corning 8163) to remove gel fragments and ethanol precipitate DNA.
Resuspend in 10-15 µL.
Run on Bioanalyzer DNA 1000 chip to check library size.
